query: INSERT INTO central.recovery_epoch_workspaces (epoch_generation, workspace_id, delivery_state, watermark_created_at, watermark_run_id, created_at, updated_at) SELECT $1, source.workspace_id, 'pending', source.created_at, source.id, clock_timestamp(), clock_timestamp() FROM ( SELECT DISTINCT ON (workspace_id) workspace_id, created_at, id FROM central.runs WHERE created_at <= $2 ORDER BY workspace_id, created_at DESC, id DESC ) AS source WHERE EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM central.recovery_epochs AS epoch WHERE epoch.epoch_generation = $1 AND epoch.coordinator_domain = $3) ON CONFLICT (epoch_generation, workspace_id) DO NOTHING
